recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered portrait of a man with voluminous curly hair, characterized by a warm, desaturated color palette and a soft-focus, hazy atmosphere typical of 1970s analog film.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's hair volume mirrors the soft texture of the background
High forehead acts as a central light-reflecting plane
Muted clothing tones recede to emphasize facial features
Thin border framing creates a window-like depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Head and shoulders portrait, centered horizontally, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the voluminous hair down to the eyes, then following the line of the collar to the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Amorphous, textured background with minimal detail to keep focus on the face.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and ochre in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal or dark navy in the shirt for base stability.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream in the collar to provide a bright point near the face.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with a compressed value range; blacks are lifted and whites are cream-toned.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, technical sans-serif for functional info paired with a delicate, spaced-out serif for the artistic title.
graphicDevices: Small technical icons/logos at top center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, technical feel of 70s metadata
Classic serif skeleton for the title text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a man with light-colored curly hair, wearing a dark shirt with a white collar. Use a warm, desaturated color palette with heavy film grain and a mottled, indistinct background. Include a thin white hairline border around the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a technical sans-serif line of text in the top center margin. Add a light, spaced-out serif title in the top left corner, ensuring it appears slightly transparent or integrated into the background texture.

verificationChecks: Is the hair texture soft and voluminous?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones?
Is there a visible film grain across the entire image?
Is the typography clean and period-accurate?

mustRedesign: Do not use vibrant or saturated colors
postGenerationChecks: Check for lifted blacks in the histogram
Ensure the skin tones are warm but desaturated
Verify the presence of a thin white border
Confirm the typography is uppercase and appropriately spaced
recipe.reuseFormula: Analog Portrait + 70s Film Stock + Soft Focus + Earth Tone Palette + Minimalist Serif Typography
